integrity: All finite objects are reconstructed from definitions by the bundled standard-library verifier. It independently compares metric compatibility with disjoint radius-one Lee balls, proves the maximum by complete branch-and-bound, enumerates all normalized maxima, generates the full labeled census, and checks the stated isometry orbit and universal profiles.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite result only for arbitrary codes in \(\mathbb Z_5^3\) at minimum Lee distance \(3\); no claim for other parameters or asymptotics. The exhaustive proof is computer-assisted and has not received an independent audit.
title: Exact optimum and equality census for \(\mathbb Z_5^3\) Lee codes of distance three
